name: email-drafter
summary_zh: 根据收件人、目的与事实要点起草专业邮件或通知草稿，覆盖跟进、请求、婉拒与致歉等常见场景。输入为场景说明与关键事实；输出含主题、正文与行动要求。适合行政、门店与采购等对外沟通。
why_recommended_zh: T01.s1 · 明确对象与目的：帮助先厘清读者、诉求与可写入事实，再进入起草。
known_limitations_zh: 仅起草、不发送；需人工核对付方称呼、日期与组织用语。不适合未经复核的法律或高度敏感函件。
summary_en: Draft professional emails or notices from recipient, purpose, and key facts—covering follow-ups, requests, polite declines, and apologies. Input is a scenario brief plus facts; output includes subject, body, and a clear ask. Suited to admin, retail, and procurement outbound writing.
why_recommended_en: T01.s1 · Clarify audience & purpose: Helps pin down reader, ask, and writable facts before drafting begins.
known_limitations_en: Drafts only—does not send. Manually verify names, dates, and house style. Not suitable for legal or highly sensitive letters without human review.

name: internal-comms
summary_zh: 按常见内部格式撰写进度、周报、FAQ、事故说明与领导层更新等对内文稿。输入为沟通类型与事实要点；输出为可套用的结构化草稿。适合需要统一内部口径的团队。
why_recommended_zh: T01.s2 · 起草内容：按类型加载写作指引，直接产出可审阅的内部通知或汇报草稿。
known_limitations_zh: 依赖组织自有模板与事实清单；不会自动获知未提供的内部数据。语气需对照读者层级再调。
summary_en: Write internal updates in common formats—status notes, weekly reports, FAQs, incident briefs, and leadership updates. Input is the comms type and fact list; output is a structured draft ready for review. Suited to teams that need consistent internal voice.
why_recommended_en: T01.s2 · Draft the content: Loads type-specific writing guidance and produces a reviewable internal notice or report draft.
known_limitations_en: Relies on your templates and fact checklist; it cannot invent unprovided internal data. Retune tone for the audience level.

name: fact-checker
summary_zh: 从文稿中抽取可核验陈述，对照公开权威来源比对正误与是否过时，并给出带出处的更正建议。输入为待核文档；输出为核对报告与可选修订。适合交付前的事实与语气终核。
why_recommended_zh: T01.s3 · 修改核对：对草稿做逐条事实核对并建议修订，支撑修改核对产物。
known_limitations_zh: 无法核验主观评价或付费墙内资料；更正须经用户确认后再改稿。来源冲突时只列差异，不擅自定论。
summary_en: Extract checkable claims from a draft, compare them to public authoritative sources for accuracy and staleness, and suggest sourced corrections. Input is the document to verify; output is a check report and optional revisions. Suited to final fact and tone review before delivery.
why_recommended_en: T01.s3 · Revise & verify: Runs claim-by-claim fact checks on the draft and suggests revisions that support the revise-and-verify deliverable.
known_limitations_en: Cannot verify opinions or paywalled material. Apply corrections only after user confirmation. On conflicting sources, lists differences without declaring a winner.

name: board-pre-read
summary_zh: 整理会前预读包：TL;DR、指标对照计划、进展与问题、需董事会决策事项与风险。输入为关键数字与决策诉求；输出为可提前分发的预读文稿。适合经营汇报准备。
why_recommended_zh: T02.s1 · 整理材料：把分散指标与要点整理成带出处的证据与决策清单。
known_limitations_zh: 数字与计划口径须由用户提供；不替代正式财务审计。预读需提前分发才有效，会议现场仍需人工主持决策。
summary_en: Assemble a pre-meeting packet: TL;DR, metrics versus plan, progress and issues, board decisions needed, and risks. Input is key numbers and decision asks; output is a pre-read ready to circulate early. Suited to operating reviews and governance prep.
why_recommended_en: T02.s1 · Organize materials: Turns scattered metrics and talking points into sourced evidence and a decision checklist.
known_limitations_en: Numbers and plan definitions must come from the user; not a substitute for formal financial audit. Pre-reads only help if circulated early—live meetings still need a human chair.

name: ai-slides
summary_zh: 从大纲或材料生成结构完整的演示文稿草稿，覆盖结论先行页、正文与附录式分页。输入为要点与篇幅约束；输出为可继续精修的幻灯片结构。适合汇报与演示成稿。
why_recommended_zh: T02.s2 · 组织与成稿：把证据与结论组织成可交付的报告/演示结构。 | T02.s3 · 检查交付：便于按页核对数字与格式后再交付。
known_limitations_zh: 版式与品牌规范需人工对齐；复杂图表与敏感数据须复核。依赖可用的演示文件生成能力。
summary_en: Generate a structured slide draft from an outline or source materials—conclusion-first openers, body sections, and appendix-style pages. Input is key points and length constraints; output is a slide structure ready for polish. Suited to briefings and presentation drafting.
why_recommended_en: T02.s2 · Structure & draft: Organizes evidence and conclusions into a deliverable report or deck structure. | T02.s3 · Check before delivery: Makes page-by-page checks of numbers and formatting before handoff easier.
known_limitations_en: Layout and brand rules need human alignment; complex charts and sensitive data must be reviewed. Depends on available slide-file generation capabilities.

name: deep-research
summary_zh: 围绕研究问题做多角度资料搜集与结构化分析，输出带范围、子问题与成功标准的调研框架及报告骨架。输入为课题与约束；输出为问题界定与研究大纲。适合开题与范围锁定。
why_recommended_zh: T03.s1 · 界定问题：把模糊课题收敛为可执行的问题、范围与成功标准。
known_limitations_zh: 结论质量取决于可访问来源；不保证覆盖付费或内部库。需人工排除项与时间范围。
summary_en: Frame a research question with multi-angle gathering and structured analysis, producing a scoped framework with sub-questions, success criteria, and a report skeleton. Input is the topic and constraints; output is a problem definition and research outline. Suited to kickoff and scope lock.
why_recommended_en: T03.s1 · Frame the question: Narrows a vague topic into executable questions, scope, and success criteria.
known_limitations_en: Conclusion quality depends on accessible sources; paid or internal libraries are not guaranteed. Humans must set exclusions and time bounds.

name: company-research
summary_zh: 对企业商业模式、市场位置、管理与竞争格局做尽职调查式整理，输出带来源标注的材料与综合结论要点。输入为公司名与调研目的；输出为结构化公司档案。适合尽调与选型前背景摸底。
why_recommended_zh: T03.s2 · 搜集核实：按维度搜集并标注可访问来源与日期。 | T03.s3 · 综合结论：把证据收成结论、依据与未知项清单。
known_limitations_zh: 公开信息可能滞后或不完整；非投资建议。交叉核实与可信度标注仍需人工把关。
summary_en: Produce diligence-style notes on a company's business model, market position, leadership, and competitive landscape, with source-annotated materials and synthesis bullets. Input is company name and research purpose; output is a structured company brief. Suited to backgrounding before diligence or vendor selection.
why_recommended_en: T03.s2 · Gather & verify: Collects by dimension and annotates accessible sources with dates. | T03.s3 · Synthesize findings: Rolls evidence into conclusions, supporting grounds, and an unknowns list.
known_limitations_en: Public information may be stale or incomplete; not investment advice. Cross-checks and credibility labels still need human judgment.

name: competitive-analysis
summary_zh: 系统比较竞品产品、功能、定价与定位，输出比较维度、证据表与取舍建议。输入为比较对象与约束；输出为功能矩阵与推荐理由。适合选型、采购与市场对照。
why_recommended_zh: T04.s1 · 确定标准：先钉死可度量维度、权重与硬约束。 | T04.s2 · 比较证据：按方案×维度填证据并保留来源。 | T04.s3 · 做出取舍：给出与标准一致的推荐、放弃理由与敏感假设。
known_limitations_zh: 缺失数据须标「未知」而非臆造；定价与功能可能随时变更。不替代合规或合同审查。
summary_en: Systematically compare competing products on features, pricing, and positioning, producing comparison dimensions, an evidence table, and trade-off recommendations. Input is the set of options and constraints; output is a feature matrix with reasoned picks. Suited to selection, procurement, and market contrasts.
why_recommended_en: T04.s1 · Set criteria: Locks measurable dimensions, weights, and hard constraints first. | T04.s2 · Compare evidence: Fills an option×dimension evidence grid while retaining sources. | T04.s3 · Decide & trade off: Gives a recommendation aligned to the criteria, with drop reasons and sensitive assumptions.
known_limitations_en: Missing data must be marked unknown—not invented. Pricing and features can change anytime. Does not replace compliance or contract review.

name: explore-data
summary_zh: 对新表或文件做形态、空值、分布与可疑值画像，输出质量问题清单与可分析维度建议。输入为表名或 CSV/Excel；输出为探查报告。适合分析前摸底与口径讨论。
why_recommended_zh: T05.s1 · 检查数据：列出缺失/重复/异常位置与数量，形成清洗计划。 | T06.s1 · 明确口径：帮助明确粒度、时间范围与可分析指标口径。
known_limitations_zh: 不改原始文件；大表探查依赖运行环境与连接器。画像结论需结合业务定义再定清洗规则。
summary_en: Profile a new table or file for shape, nulls, distributions, and suspicious values, producing a quality-issue list and suggested analysis dimensions. Input is a table name or CSV/Excel; output is an exploration report. Suited to pre-analysis grounding and metric-definition talks.
why_recommended_en: T05.s1 · Inspect data: Lists where and how many missing, duplicate, or anomalous values appear to seed a cleaning plan. | T06.s1 · Define metrics: Helps clarify grain, time range, and analyzable metric definitions.
known_limitations_en: Does not modify source files; large-table profiling depends on runtime and connectors. Profile findings need business definitions before cleaning rules are final.

name: csv-excel-merger
summary_zh: 合并、拼接或按键关联多份 CSV/Excel，映射列名、规范化键值、去重并校验行数。输入为多个表格；输出为统一 schema 的结果表与修改说明。适合清洗规范阶段。
why_recommended_zh: T05.s2 · 清洗规范：把多源表整理成可回溯修改的标准化表格。
known_limitations_zh: 模糊列映射需人工确认；键规范化规则影响去重结果。大文件受内存与 pandas 环境影响。
summary_en: Merge, concatenate, or key-join multiple CSV/Excel files—mapping columns, normalizing keys, deduplicating, and validating row counts. Input is several sheets; output is a unified-schema result table plus a change log. Suited to the clean-and-normalize stage.
why_recommended_en: T05.s2 · Clean & normalize: Turns multi-source sheets into a standardized table with an auditable change trail.
known_limitations_en: Fuzzy column maps need human confirmation; key-normalization rules affect dedupe outcomes. Large files are limited by memory and the pandas environment.

name: validate-data
summary_zh: 在分享前复核分析方法、计算与结论是否被数据支撑，输出置信评估与改进建议。输入为分析文档、SQL 或图表；输出为校验清单。适合表格交付前对账。
why_recommended_zh: T05.s3 · 校验交付：对行数、合计与剩余问题做交付前校验。
known_limitations_zh: 无法发现用户未提供的隐含假设；抽样复核不等于全量审计。结论仍须业务方终签。
summary_en: Before sharing, re-check whether methods, calculations, and conclusions are supported by the data, producing a confidence assessment and improvement notes. Input is an analysis doc, SQL, or charts; output is a validation checklist. Suited to pre-delivery reconciliation of spreadsheet work.
why_recommended_en: T05.s3 · Validate delivery: Validates row counts, totals, and remaining issues before handoff.
known_limitations_en: Cannot surface hidden assumptions the user never provided; sample rechecks are not a full audit. Business owners still give final sign-off.

name: data-analysis
summary_zh: 对 Excel/CSV 做可复核计算、洞察提炼与基础可视化，输出公式/步骤可复现的结果。输入为数据集与分析问题；输出为计算结果与图表草稿。适合分析计算阶段。
why_recommended_zh: T06.s2 · 分析计算：产出可复现计算过程与抽样可对账的结果。
known_limitations_zh: 不引入外部假数据；口径冲突须先解决。复杂统计推断需专业复核。
summary_en: Run reviewable calculations, insight extraction, and basic visualization on Excel/CSV, with reproducible formulas or steps. Input is a dataset and analysis question; output is computed results and chart drafts. Suited to the analyze-and-compute stage.
why_recommended_en: T06.s2 · Analyze & compute: Produces a reproducible calculation path and sample-reconcileable results.
known_limitations_en: Does not invent external fake data; definition conflicts must be resolved first. Complex statistical inference needs specialist review.

name: build-dashboard
summary_zh: 生成含图表、筛选与表格的自包含 HTML 仪表盘，便于浏览器打开分享。输入为指标说明与数据；输出为可打开的仪表盘文件。适合呈现核验与汇报。
why_recommended_zh: T06.s3 · 呈现核验：把核验后的数字呈现为带标注的图表与报表。
known_limitations_zh: 默认嵌入快照数据，非实时源；图表类型与无障碍需人工检查。敏感数据分享前须脱敏。
summary_en: Build a self-contained HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables that open in a browser for sharing. Input is metric descriptions and data; output is an openable dashboard file. Suited to presentation, verification, and reporting.
why_recommended_en: T06.s3 · Present & verify: Turns verified numbers into annotated charts and reports.
known_limitations_en: Embeds snapshot data by default—not a live source. Chart choices and accessibility need human checks. Desensitize sensitive data before sharing.

name: backwards-design-unit-planner
summary_zh: 按理解设计（UbD）从学习结果出发，依次产出目标、评估证据与学习活动序列及对齐检查。输入为目标、学段与课时；输出为三阶段单元计划。适合备课与培训设计。
why_recommended_zh: T07.s1 · 确定教学目标：把受众与可评估学习目标写清。 | T07.s2 · 组织课程材料：再组织与目标对齐的教案/活动序列。
known_limitations_zh: 输出为单元框架而非逐课详案；目标表述越具体质量越高。本技能采用 CC-BY-SA-4.0：转载或衍生公开内容时须保留原作者署名，并以相同方式共享。详情见上游许可证全文。
summary_en: Follow Understanding by Design (UbD) from desired results outward to produce goals, assessment evidence, a learning-activity sequence, and alignment checks. Input is goals, grade band, and contact hours; output is a three-stage unit plan. Suited to lesson prep and training design.
why_recommended_en: T07.s1 · Set learning goals: Clarifies audience and assessable learning objectives. | T07.s2 · Organize course materials: Then organizes lesson/activity sequences aligned to those goals.
known_limitations_en: Produces a unit framework, not lesson-by-lesson scripts; more specific goals yield better quality. This skill uses CC-BY-SA-4.0: when you republish or derive public content, retain original author attribution and share alike. See the upstream license for full terms.

name: retrieval-practice-generator
summary_zh: 按检索练习原则生成不同难度与题型的回忆题，附答案要点与课堂实施建议。输入为知识点、学段与题量；输出为练习集与解析。适合设计练习与检查。
why_recommended_zh: T07.s3 · 设计练习与检查：产出对应目标、含答案与难度梯度的练习。
known_limitations_zh: 术语须对照本校教材再核；低先验或二语学习者需提高有提示题比例。本技能采用 CC-BY-SA-4.0：转载或衍生公开内容时须保留原作者署名，并以相同方式共享。详情见上游许可证全文。
summary_en: Generate recall questions across difficulties and formats using retrieval-practice principles, with answer keys and classroom tips. Input is topics, grade band, and item count; output is a practice set with explanations. Suited to designing practice and checks.
why_recommended_en: T07.s3 · Design practice & checks: Produces goal-aligned practice with answers and a difficulty gradient.
known_limitations_en: Re-check terminology against local curricula; raise the share of cued items for low-prior-knowledge or L2 learners. This skill uses CC-BY-SA-4.0: when you republish or derive public content, retain original author attribution and share alike. See the upstream license for full terms.

name: mind-map
summary_zh: 把主题、脑暴或文档整理为可渲染的 Mermaid 思维导图，标明分支组织原则。输入为中心主题与素材；输出为导图代码与结构说明。适合梳理知识框架。
why_recommended_zh: T08.s1 · 梳理知识：把学习范围收成可见的知识结构图/大纲。
known_limitations_zh: 依赖 Mermaid 渲染环境；过深分支需人工裁剪。不替代领域专家对先修关系的裁定。
summary_en: Turn a topic, brainstorm, or document into a renderable Mermaid mind map with stated branch-organization principles. Input is a central theme and source material; output is map code plus a structure note. Suited to outlining knowledge frameworks.
why_recommended_en: T08.s1 · Map knowledge: Collapses the learning scope into a visible knowledge structure or outline.
known_limitations_en: Needs a Mermaid-capable renderer; deep trees need human pruning. Does not replace domain experts on prerequisite edges.

name: sql-query-explainer
summary_zh: 用白话解释、优化、编写或文档化 SQL，面向业务方说明输出形状与假设。输入为查询或自然语言需求；输出为讲解、注释查询或数据字典。适合编排带示例的学习材料。
why_recommended_zh: T08.s2 · 编排学习材料：把查询逻辑讲成可贴合学习者场景的讲解与示例。
known_limitations_zh: 方言差异会影响语义；无 schema 时假设须明示。优化建议需结合真实执行计划再验证。
summary_en: Explain, optimize, write, or document SQL in plain language for business readers—covering output shape and assumptions. Input is a query or a natural-language ask; output is an explanation, annotated query, or data dictionary. Suited to arranging learning materials with examples.
why_recommended_en: T08.s2 · Arrange learning materials: Turns query logic into explanations and examples that fit the learner's context.
known_limitations_en: Dialect differences can change meaning; state assumptions when no schema is provided. Optimization tips need validation against real execution plans.

name: quiz-generator
summary_zh: 按学习目标生成混合题型与难度的测验，附完整答案解析与干扰项说明。输入为目标与考查范围；输出为题目与答案键。适合编制练习与自检。
why_recommended_zh: T08.s3 · 编制练习与解析：产出覆盖要点、带解析与可执行自检的练习。
known_limitations_zh: 题干与答案须对照实际教学内容；不自动防泄题。高利害考试仍需人工命题规范。
summary_en: Generate mixed-format, mixed-difficulty quizzes from learning objectives, with full answer keys and distractor notes. Input is objectives and coverage; output is items plus an answer key. Suited to building practice and self-checks.
why_recommended_en: T08.s3 · Build drills & keys: Produces coverage of key points with explanations and executable self-checks.
known_limitations_en: Stems and keys must be checked against actual teaching content; no automatic leak prevention. High-stakes exams still need human item-writing standards.

name: research
summary_zh: 针对工程问题检索官方文档、源码与规范等一手来源，将带出处的发现写入仓库 Markdown。输入为调研问题；输出为引用可追溯的笔记文件。适合产品研究准备阶段。
why_recommended_zh: T09.s1 · 准备研究：用一手来源支撑研究目标、假设与提纲准备。
known_limitations_zh: 偏工程文档与源码语境；不替代用户访谈。后台代理可用性取决于运行环境。
summary_en: For an engineering question, search primary sources—official docs, source code, and specs—and write cited findings into repo Markdown. Input is the research question; output is a traceable notes file. Suited to product-research prep when engineering context matters.
why_recommended_en: T09.s1 · Prepare research: Grounds research goals, hypotheses, and outline prep in primary sources.
known_limitations_en: Skewed toward engineering docs and source-code contexts; not a substitute for user interviews. Background-agent availability depends on the runtime.

name: research-synthesis
summary_zh: 把访谈、问卷、可用性笔记或反馈综合为主题、洞察与行动建议。输入为研究材料；输出为模式、用户分段与优先下一步。适合分析研究材料。
why_recommended_zh: T09.s2 · 分析材料：从材料中抽出带来源的摘要、证据与需求线索。
known_limitations_zh: 洞察代表性受样本限制；须区分观察与推断。不含完整访谈主持方法（见配套研究技能）。
summary_en: Synthesize interviews, surveys, usability notes, or feedback into themes, insights, and recommended next steps. Input is research materials; output is patterns, segments, and prioritized follow-ups. Suited to analyzing research materials.
why_recommended_en: T09.s2 · Analyze materials: Extracts sourced summaries, evidence, and need signals from the materials.
known_limitations_en: Insight representativeness is sample-bound; separate observation from inference. Does not include full interview-facilitation methods (see companion research skills).

name: synthesize-research
summary_zh: 将用户研究结果收成有多证据支撑的洞察、待验证假设与边界说明。输入为已整理线索；输出为结论包与未决项。适合形成产品研究结论。
why_recommended_zh: T09.s3 · 形成结论：产出洞察、依据与待验证假设，避免夸大样本。
known_limitations_zh: 不扩大样本外推；证据不足时应标未知。需与产品目标对齐后再排优先级。
summary_en: Roll user-research findings into multi-evidence insights, hypotheses to test, and boundary notes. Input is already-organized clues; output is a conclusion pack plus open items. Suited to forming product-research conclusions.
why_recommended_en: T09.s3 · Form conclusions: Produces insights, grounds, and testable hypotheses without overclaiming the sample.
known_limitations_en: Do not extrapolate beyond the sample; mark unknowns when evidence is thin. Align to product goals before prioritizing.

name: idea-refine
summary_zh: 把模糊产品想法澄清为问题陈述、用户、成功指标与范围边界。输入为原始点子；输出为可评审的问题与边界说明。适合澄清问题与范围。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s1 · 澄清问题与范围：收敛问题、目标用户、成功指标与范围内外。
known_limitations_zh: 不代替市场验证；假设须显式列出。输出为澄清稿，非完整 PRD。
summary_en: Clarify a fuzzy product idea into a problem statement, users, success metrics, and scope boundaries. Input is the raw idea; output is a reviewable problem-and-boundary brief. Suited to clarifying problem and scope.
why_recommended_en: T10.s1 · Clarify problem & scope: Converges on the problem, target users, success metrics, and in/out of scope.
known_limitations_en: Does not replace market validation; list assumptions explicitly. Output is a clarification brief, not a full PRD.

name: to-spec
summary_zh: 把当前讨论与代码库上下文合成为可发布的规格说明，并写入项目议题跟踪。输入为已有对话；输出为问题陈述与规格正文。适合定义需求文档。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s2 · 定义需求：把已澄清需求整理成可执行规格与用户故事骨架。
known_limitations_zh: 默认不再访谈用户；上下文不足时规格可能偏薄。发布议题依赖已配置的跟踪器。
summary_en: Synthesize the current discussion and codebase context into a publishable specification and write it into the project's issue tracker. Input is existing conversation; output is a problem statement plus spec body. Suited to defining requirements documents.
why_recommended_en: T10.s2 · Define requirements: Turns clarified needs into an executable spec and user-story skeleton.
known_limitations_en: By default does not re-interview users; thin context yields thin specs. Publishing issues depends on a configured tracker.

name: to-tickets
summary_zh: 把规格拆成可独立验证的纵向切片工单，控制体量以便单次上下文完成。输入为规格；输出为可排期的工单列表。适合验收标准与拆分对齐。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s3 · 核对验收：把需求落成可测切片与验收路径，便于核对缺口。
known_limitations_zh: 切片质量依赖规格完整度；跨仓依赖需人工标注。不自动估点或排期。
summary_en: Split a specification into independently verifiable vertical-slice tickets sized for a single context window. Input is a spec; output is a schedulable ticket list. Suited to aligning acceptance criteria and decomposition.
why_recommended_en: T10.s3 · Align acceptance: Lands requirements as testable slices and acceptance paths so gaps are easier to spot.
known_limitations_en: Slice quality depends on spec completeness; cross-repo dependencies need human labels. Does not auto-estimate or schedule.

name: frontend-ui-engineering
summary_zh: 构建可访问、响应式、生产级观感的用户界面与组件，强调设计系统与真实交互状态。输入为界面需求；输出为组件/页面实现。适合梳理流程后的界面落地。
why_recommended_zh: T11.s1 · 梳理用户流程：在实现中落实主/异常流程与空/加载/错误等状态约束。
known_limitations_zh: 视觉还原仍需对照设计稿；无障碍需按 WCAG 再测。不替代产品流程决策。
summary_en: Build accessible, responsive, production-feel user interfaces and components with design-system discipline and real interaction states. Input is UI requirements; output is component/page implementations. Suited to shipping UI after flows are mapped.
why_recommended_en: T11.s1 · Map user flows: Encodes primary/exception flows and empty/loading/error state constraints in the implementation.
known_limitations_en: Visual fidelity still needs design-file checks; accessibility needs WCAG retesting. Does not replace product flow decisions.

name: frontend-design
summary_zh: 为新界面或改版提供有辨识度的视觉方向、字体与布局取舍，避免模板化默认审美。输入为简报与内容主题；输出为可落地的视觉方案指引或代码草稿。适合方案探索与文案配套界面。
why_recommended_zh: T11.s2 · 探索界面方案：产出可比较、贴合主题的界面方案方向。 | T12.s2 · 编写文案：为页面与控件文案预留贴合视觉的承载结构。
known_limitations_zh: 强观点设计需与品牌规范对齐；动效应克制。不覆盖平面/工业/空间设计。
summary_en: Propose distinctive visual direction, typography, and layout choices for new UI or redesigns—avoiding generic template aesthetics. Input is a brief and content theme; output is actionable visual guidance or code drafts. Suited to concept exploration and copy-ready layouts.
why_recommended_en: T11.s2 · Explore UI directions: Produces comparable, theme-fit interface directions. | T12.s2 · Write UI copy: Reserves visual structure that can carry page and control copy.
known_limitations_en: Opinionated design must still align to brand rules; motion should stay restrained. Does not cover print, industrial, or spatial design.

name: apple-design
summary_zh: 把 Apple 流体界面与物理动效原则转译到 Web：即时反馈、可中断弹簧、手势与深度材质。输入为交互场景；输出为设计与实现指引。适合体验走查与手势流优化。
why_recommended_zh: T11.s3 · 检查体验：按平台启发式检查反馈、延迟与可中断动效。
known_limitations_zh: 主要面向 Web 转译，非原生 iOS SDK 教程；须尊重 reduced-motion。不宣称覆盖全部 Apple HIG 条款。
summary_en: Translate Apple fluid-UI and physical-motion principles to the web: instant feedback, interruptible springs, gestures, and depth materials. Input is an interaction scenario; output is design and implementation guidance. Suited to experience reviews and gesture-flow polish.
why_recommended_en: T11.s3 · Review experience: Checks feedback, latency, and interruptible motion against platform heuristics.
known_limitations_en: Aimed at web translation, not a native iOS SDK tutorial; respect reduced-motion. Does not claim full Apple HIG coverage.

name: ux-copy
summary_zh: 撰写或审阅按钮、错误、空态、确认框与引导等微文案，强调清晰、简短与一致。输入为场景与语气约定；输出为可用文案稿。适合语气约定与一致性检查。
why_recommended_zh: T12.s1 · 明确语气与场景：帮助钉死读者、语气与用词约定。 | T12.s3 · 检查一致性：核对术语一致、状态覆盖与本地化可行性。
known_limitations_zh: 字符限制与品牌用语表需用户提供；不自动完成全站词库治理。多语言复数/变量须人工再核。
summary_en: Write or review microcopy for buttons, errors, empty states, confirms, and onboarding—favoring clarity, brevity, and consistency. Input is scenarios and tone rules; output is usable copy drafts. Suited to tone agreements and consistency checks.
why_recommended_en: T12.s1 · Set tone & scenarios: Helps lock reader, tone, and wording agreements. | T12.s3 · Check consistency: Checks terminology consistency, state coverage, and localization feasibility.
known_limitations_en: Character limits and brand glossaries must be provided; does not finish whole-site glossary governance. Plurals and variables in other locales need human recheck.

name: codebase-design
summary_zh: 用「深模块」词汇设计接口与接缝：小接口承载多行为、可测、便于维护。输入为设计意图；输出为模块/接缝方案。适合设计与拆解阶段。
why_recommended_zh: T13.s1 · 设计与拆解：把方案落到清晰接口、实施步骤与风险接缝。
known_limitations_zh: 需结合现有仓库约束；不自动生成全部实现。术语须与团队 glossary 对齐。
summary_en: Design interfaces and seams with “deep module” vocabulary: small interfaces that carry rich behavior, stay testable, and stay maintainable. Input is design intent; output is a module/seam proposal. Suited to design-and-decompose stages.
why_recommended_en: T13.s1 · Design & decompose: Lands the approach as clear interfaces, implementation steps, and risk seams.
known_limitations_en: Must respect the existing repo; does not auto-generate full implementations. Align terms to the team glossary.

name: tdd
summary_zh: 按红—绿—重构循环先写行为测试再写最小实现，明确接缝与反模式。输入为行为描述与技术栈；输出为可执行的 TDD 循环指引与测试。适合实现与缺陷修复验证。
why_recommended_zh: T13.s2 · 实现与测试：用测试先行驱动可运行实现。 | T14.s2 · 修复与验证：修复时先失败后通过的针对性测试。
known_limitations_zh: 接缝须事先与用户确认；禁止测实现细节。测试框架与目录约定依赖项目现状。
summary_en: Follow a red–green–refactor loop: write behavioral tests first, then the minimal implementation, with explicit seams and anti-patterns. Input is behavior descriptions and stack; output is executable TDD guidance and tests. Suited to implementation and bug-fix verification.
why_recommended_en: T13.s2 · Implement & test: Drives a runnable implementation with tests first. | T14.s2 · Fix & verify: For fixes, requires failing-then-passing targeted tests.
known_limitations_en: Confirm seams with the user first; do not test implementation details. Test frameworks and folder conventions follow the project's current setup.

name: code-review
summary_zh: 相对固定基点做双轴评审：是否符合仓库规范、是否兑现规格/议题，并行汇总发现。输入为基点与变更；输出为对照报告。适合评审与交付说明。
why_recommended_zh: T13.s3 · 评审与交付：产出规范与规格双轴评审记录，支撑交付说明。
known_limitations_zh: 依赖可解析的 git 基点与议题来源；空 diff 会中止。不替代安全专项审计。
summary_en: Run a dual-axis review against a fixed baseline: does the change match repo conventions, and does it fulfill the spec/issue—summarizing findings in parallel. Input is baseline and diff; output is a paired report. Suited to review and delivery notes.
why_recommended_en: T13.s3 · Review & ship notes: Produces convention-and-spec dual-axis review notes that support delivery write-ups.
known_limitations_en: Needs a parseable git baseline and issue source; empty diffs abort. Not a substitute for dedicated security audits.

name: diagnosing-bugs
summary_zh: 以紧反馈环驱动难复现缺陷与性能回退诊断：先建可红信号，再二分与假设检验。输入为故障现象；输出为复现步骤、证据与根因。适合复现与定位。
why_recommended_zh: T14.s1 · 复现与定位：强制稳定复现、证据与有支撑的根因。
known_limitations_zh: 须先脱敏密钥与鉴权头；无反馈环时不空谈根因。人机点击环为最后手段。
summary_en: Drive hard-to-reproduce bugs and performance regressions with a tight feedback loop: establish a red signal first, then bisect and hypothesis-test. Input is the failure symptom; output is repro steps, evidence, and root cause. Suited to reproduce-and-locate work.
why_recommended_en: T14.s1 · Reproduce & locate: Requires a stable repro, evidence, and a grounded root cause.
known_limitations_en: Strip secrets and auth headers first; do not speculate on root cause without a feedback loop. Human click-loops are a last resort.

name: verification-before-completion
summary_zh: 在宣称完成、通过或可合并前，强制先跑核验命令并阅读完整输出，以证据说话。输入为待宣称状态；输出为带证据的状态说明。适合回归与检查收口。
why_recommended_zh: T14.s3 · 回归与检查：要求新鲜核验证据后再给出回归结论与修复说明。
known_limitations_zh: 核验命令须由任务上下文定义；跳过任一步即视为未核验。不替代发布审批流程。
summary_en: Before claiming done, passing, or merge-ready, require running verification commands and reading full output—evidence first. Input is the claimed status; output is a status note with evidence. Suited to regression and close-out checks.
why_recommended_en: T14.s3 · Regress & check: Demands fresh verification evidence before stating regression conclusions and fix notes.
known_limitations_en: Verification commands must be defined by task context; skipping any step counts as unverified. Does not replace release-approval process.

name: ecommerce-growth-strategy
summary_zh: 用单位经济与增长杠杆诊断电商现状，识别流量、转化、客单、留存与扩张机会，并给出约 90 天优先级路线图。输入为品类、平台与目标；输出为诊断与行动计划。适合营销经营全链路策展。
why_recommended_zh: T15.s1 · 明确对象与目标：澄清受众分群、可衡量目标与预算/时间约束。 | T15.s2 · 制定定位与渠道：给出定位陈述、渠道选择与竞争对照理由。 | T15.s3 · 编排执行计划：编排内容节奏、负责人与衡量指标。 | T16.s1 · 整理指标：整理 CAC/LTV/AOV 等口径一致的经营指标。 | T16.s2 · 分析变化与问题：量化变化并区分相关与因果假设。 | T16.s3 · 制定改进行动：落成带负责人与跟踪指标的改进行动。
known_limitations_zh: 偏电商/多渠道经营语境；基准数据为参考非承诺。缺失数字会标注估计，须业务方核验后再执行。
summary_en: Diagnose ecommerce health with unit economics and growth levers—traffic, conversion, AOV, retention, and expansion—then outline an ~90-day priority roadmap. Input is category, platforms, and goals; output is a diagnosis and action plan. Suited to end-to-end marketing and operating curation.
why_recommended_en: T15.s1 · Clarify audience & goals: Clarifies audience segments, measurable goals, and budget/time constraints. | T15.s2 · Set positioning & channels: Gives a positioning statement, channel choices, and competitive-contrast rationale. | T15.s3 · Sequence the plan: Sequences content cadence, owners, and success metrics. | T16.s1 · Organize metrics: Organizes CAC/LTV/AOV and related operating metrics on consistent definitions. | T16.s2 · Analyze changes & issues: Quantifies changes and separates correlation from causal hypotheses. | T16.s3 · Plan improvements: Lands improvement actions with owners and tracking metrics.
known_limitations_en: Skewed to ecommerce/multi-channel operating contexts; benchmarks are references, not promises. Missing numbers are marked estimates and must be verified by the business before execution.

name: grill-me
summary_zh: 用尖锐问题拷问你的计划与设计假设，暴露缺口与未验证前提。输入为计划或设计草案；输出为加压问题清单与需补强点。适合澄清问题与范围后的压力测试。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s1 · 澄清问题与范围：与 idea-refine 并列——提炼方向后再加压验证缺口。
known_limitations_zh: 入口 grill-me 转发至 grilling；不代替用户研究或市场验证。问题清单需人工筛选优先级。
summary_en: Stress-test plans and design assumptions with hard questions to surface gaps and unvalidated premises. Input is a plan or design draft; output is a pressure-question list and strengthening points. Suited to pressure-testing after clarifying problem and scope.
why_recommended_en: T10.s1 · Clarify problem & scope: Alongside idea-refine—refine the idea, then pressure-test gaps.
known_limitations_en: Entry grill-me forwards to grilling; does not replace user research or market validation. Humans should prioritize the question list.

name: brainstorming
summary_zh: 动手前先澄清意图、约束与成功标准，把模糊目标收敛成可执行的设计前提。输入为原始诉求；输出为澄清后的意图与边界。适合实现前想清楚。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s1 · 澄清问题与范围：补 Superpowers 缺口，把「想清楚」放在编码之前。
known_limitations_zh: 依赖对话上下文；不会自动获知未提供的业务约束。输出为澄清稿，非完整规格。
summary_en: Clarify intent, constraints, and success criteria before building—converge fuzzy goals into executable design premises. Input is the raw ask; output is clarified intent and boundaries. Suited to thinking clearly before implementation.
why_recommended_en: T10.s1 · Clarify problem & scope: Fills a Superpowers gap—think clearly before coding.
known_limitations_en: Depends on conversation context; will not invent unstated business constraints. Output is a clarification brief, not a full spec.

name: writing-plans
summary_zh: 把已澄清的规格拆成可执行的分步计划。输入为规格或需求要点；输出为有序步骤与检查点。适合定义需求后的计划拆解。
why_recommended_zh: T10.s2 · 定义需求：与 to-spec 并列——规格合成之后做计划拆解。
known_limitations_zh: 计划粒度依赖规格完整度；不替代项目管理排期与估点。教学占位路径非真实资产。
summary_en: Break a clarified spec into an actionable step-by-step plan. Input is a spec or requirement notes; output is ordered steps and checkpoints. Suited to plan decomposition after defining requirements.
why_recommended_en: T10.s2 · Define requirements: Alongside to-spec—after the spec, decompose the plan.
known_limitations_en: Plan granularity depends on spec completeness; does not replace project scheduling or estimates. Tutorial placeholder paths are not real assets.

name: systematic-debugging
summary_zh: 结构化排查：提出假设、收集证据、二分定位并回归验证。输入为故障现象；输出为排查记录与根因结论。适合复现与定位。
why_recommended_zh: T14.s1 · 复现与定位：与 diagnosing-bugs 并列——流程骨架 vs 紧反馈环。
known_limitations_zh: 须先脱敏密钥与鉴权材料；无证据时不空谈根因。样例脚本仅供参考，勿在生产环境盲跑。
summary_en: Structured debugging: form hypotheses, gather evidence, bisect, and regress. Input is the failure symptom; output is an investigation log and root-cause conclusion. Suited to reproduce-and-locate work.
why_recommended_en: T14.s1 · Reproduce & locate: Alongside diagnosing-bugs—process skeleton vs tight feedback loop.
known_limitations_en: Strip secrets and auth material first; do not speculate without evidence. Sample scripts are illustrative—do not run blindly in production.
